changes.basis: Roadmap P2 composition: explicit opt-in to the existing intent-fenced V3 client through the existing borrowed sequential runner, not a new framework. Missing coverage is not a novelty claim.
changes.implementation: Capture actual V3 client; document opt-in; preserve exact-arity default V2 factory; add exact-arity V3 factory; use a private boolean constructor choosing only the two captured factories. No caller factory/mode/config field.

core.completeDelta: Comment changes two ownership labels to explicit ownership labels; configuration additionally accepts OWNED_EXISTING_V3_DISPATCH_INTENT. No BORROWED state-machine branch changes.

branches: One actual V3 client/core: two exact original/intent/funding fences before bodyless fake requests, exact Authorization/options/end0args, BOTH declared closes before next entry, maxActive1, cached auto-close/borrowed store.close0, same-array receipt without rereading mutable contents and replacement refusal.

After first completion, selected second-entry refusals retain original/possible intent, preserve attempted2/completed1 versus fake requests1, release queue and never touch entry3; failed/unknown close, no retry/rollback.

Idle close has no store/request operation. Reentrant manual close synchronously gates the queue and returns cached native child close; both declared closes remain required. Active callback and child close may finish normally while the stopped run rejects.
First fake503 drains declared handles, retains original/possible intent and failed/unknown close, and never launches queued/replacement work.

Actual core rejects unknown/accessor/proxy label inputs with hooks0; accepts three labels as frozen DATA without constructor child calls and preserves one-shot/auto-close/cached-close behavior for minimal declared private-child batches. No SQL resource is created or qualified.
